import "math"
rule Entropy_Check
{
    meta:
        description = "Prüft Entropie"
    strings:
        $mz = { 4D 5A }
        $txt = "ExampleLoader"
    condition:
        $mz at 0 and filesize < 10MB and $txt and math.entropy(0, filesize) > 7.0
}

rule CountRef
{
    strings:
        $a = "abcdef"
    condition:
        filesize < 1MB and #b > 2 and $a
}

rule Wildcards
{
    strings:
        $s1 = "alpha_one"
        $s2 = "alpha_two"
        $t = "other_text"
    condition:
        filesize < 1MB and any of ($s*) and $t
}

rule XorMod
{
    strings:
        $x = "config_value" xor(1-255)
        $b = "loader_text" base64 wide
    condition:
        filesize < 1MB and any of them
}

title: Conversion example
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    filter_a:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    filter_b:
        User: 'SYSTEM'
    condition: selection and not (filter_a or filter_b)
level: medium

expect.kql: Image endswith @"\powershell.exe" and not(ParentImage endswith @"\explorer.exe" or User =~ "SYSTEM")
